description: The two retail-agent decisions this project declares, composed with no edges: the policy relates them only through the order record's status, which this graph format's edges cannot carry faithfully (see RESIDUE.md).

cancel-pending-order.description: May this pending order be cancelled? Gates on the order status retrieved from the order record.

modify-pending-order-items.description: May these items be modified? Single-use and irreversible; taking it sets the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
